title: Appalachian Theatre of the High Country

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Appalachian Theatre presents its 2026-27 School Field Trip Series. These school-day experiences provide students with opportunities to encounter film and the performing arts in our historic 1938 Art Deco theatre. Live field trip shows are priced at $2 per seat and films are free. Reservations are available and seating is assigned on a first-come first-served basis for school groups and homeschool students. We can accommodate limited bus parking with notice. Attendees driving cars must secure parking in downtown metered spaces and lots.
